findings.evidence: Phrase: "Another says AI agents appear to be behind a wave of bank hacks" vs source title "South Korea says AI agents appear to have been used to hack the country's banks" (reuters.com) — the source does not use the word "wave" and the snippet available gives no count of incidents.
findings.suggestion: Soften to 'a string of bank hacks' or just 'bank hacks' to avoid implying a specific scale not stated in the source.

findings.evidence: Left panel: a trail of red/orange dots dripping down a table leg to the floor near the robot holding a prescription pad, in a scene about AI prescribing medicine without a doctor present.
findings.suggestion: Redraw the red drip so it clearly reads as a dropped stethoscope coil or spilled coffee (e.g. a puddle shape under the table) rather than an ambiguous drip trail that could be misread as blood near a medical scene.
